title: Unit tests for openAiText (src/inference-api/openai.ts)
instructions:
Add a new vitest unit test file `tests/inference-api/openai-text.test.ts` for `openAiText` in `src/inference-api/openai.ts`.
- Read the code first (it is pasted below) and assert what it actually does; if you think the code has a bug, say so in your final answer instead of changing it.
- Use `import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";` and import the code under test with a relative path ending in `.js` (for example `../../src/inference-api/openai.js`), like the other tests in this repository.
- Cover: a plain string is returned as is; an array of text parts is joined with newlines; non-text parts (image_url) and empty parts are skipped; null, undefined, numbers and objects give an empty string.
